milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The chiseled sandstone structure is a hollow box with walls at X=3-5, Z=2-5, centered around (4, 1, 4) spawn-relative. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to confirm visual identification. Max distance 16 and facing tolerance 60 degrees models the player being able to see the distinctive creeper-face pattern on the sandstone.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The jack_o_lantern is placed on top of the sandstone structure at (4, 3, 3) spawn-relative. The player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward it to confirm they can see the glowing orange block. This naturally follows from finding the sandstone structure below it.

Uses inventory_has because mining obsidian with a diamond pickaxe drops an obsidian item that ends up in the player's inventory. The player must mine at least 1 obsidian block from the chamber (at 7-10, 0-2, 2-6 spawn-relative). A diamond pickaxe is provided in starting inventory. Obsidian only drops when mined with diamond or netherite pickaxe.

Uses inventory_has because mining/breaking a bed drops the bed item into the player's inventory. The red bed is placed inside the obsidian chamber at (8-9, 0, 4) spawn-relative. Beds break instantly with any tool or bare hand, dropping as an item. The player must enter the obsidian chamber (potentially mining through obsidian) to reach and break the bed.
